after.note: Rule B-1: these are the ONLY conjuncts legal in decodable text at পাঠ 52; no systematic conjunct construction (Class-2 deferral). The p.77 শুনি ও পড়ি narrative additionally carries স্ব (স্বাধীন, স্বাধীনতা) and ন্য (জন্য). Neither is in the যুক্তবর্ণ শিখি box, so neither is taught at পাঠ ৫২ and neither is whitelisted. That block is শুনি ও পড়ি (listen-and-read), which is oral-exempt from the letter audit in any case.

reviewer_note: Derived by reading NCTB printed p.78 (PDF p.87; offset +9, verified against printed folio). The PDF has NO text layer — it is a scan — so the page was rasterised and read visually. Method follows the L045 precedent exactly: the whitelist is enumerated from the page's own যুক্তবর্ণ শিখি box, which is the page's statement of what it teaches.
